  (g : σ → S₁) (a : R), MvPolynomial.eval₂ f g (MvPolynomial.C a) = f a
items.informal_description: For any element $ a $ in a commutative semiring $ R $, the evaluation of the constant polynomial $ C(a) $ using coefficient map $ f : R \to S_1 $ and variable map $ g : \sigma \to S_1 $ yields $ f(a) $.

items.informal_name: Evaluation of Constant Polynomials via Algebra Map
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] [inst_2 : Algebra R S₁]
  (f : σ → S₁) (r : R), (MvPolynomial.aeval f) (MvPolynomial.C r) = (algebraMap R S₁) r
items.informal_description: For any commutative semiring $ R $, type $ \sigma $, and $ R $-algebra $ S_1 $, the evaluation of the constant polynomial $ C(r) $ in the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\sigma] $ under the algebra homomorphism $ \text{aeval} $ equals the image of $ r $ under the canonical algebra map $ R \to S_1 $. Formally, $ \text{aeval}(C(r)) = \text{algebraMap}(r) $ for all $ r \in R $.

  Polynomial.eval₂ f x (Polynomial.C a) = f a
items.informal_description: For any semiring $ R $, ring homomorphism $ f : R \to S $, element $ a \in R $, and value $ x \in S $, evaluating the constant polynomial $ C(a) $ at $ x $ using $ \text{eval}_2 $ with $ f $ yields $ f(a) $.

items.informal_name: Evaluation of Constant Polynomial Equals Algebra Map
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {A : Type z} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A] (x : A) (r : R),
  (Polynomial.aeval x) (Polynomial.C r) = (algebraMap R A) r
items.informal_description: For any element $ r $ in a commutative semiring $ R $, evaluating the constant polynomial $ C(r) $ at an element $ x $ in an $ R $-algebra $ A $ yields the same result as applying the canonical algebra homomorphism from $ R $ to $ A $ to $ r $. Symbolically, $ \text{aeval}_x(C(r)) = \text{algebraMap}(R, A)(r) $.

items.informal_name: Evaluation of Constant Polynomials Corresponds to Coefficient Homomorphism
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] (f : R →+* S₁)
  (g : σ → S₁) (r : R), (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom f g) (MvPolynomial.C r) = f r
items.informal_description: For any ring homomorphism $ f : R \to S_1 $, variable assignment $ g : \sigma \to S_1 $, and element $ r \in R $, evaluating the constant polynomial $ C(r) $ using $ f $ on coefficients and $ g $ on variables yields $ f(r) $. That is, $ \mathrm{eval}_2(f, g)(C(r)) = f(r) $.
